nights.title: Vince Staples
nights.name: Vince Staples
nights.extract: Vincent Jamal Staples is an American rapper, singer, songwriter, and actor. He first became known for his appearances on the projects from Odd Future members and affiliates, including Earl Sweatshirt's Earl (2010) and Doris (2013), Mike G.’s Ali (2010) and The Jet Age of Tomorrow's Journey to the 5th Echelon (2010). He signed with Talib Kweli's Blacksmith Records prior to the release of his collaborative mixtape with Mac Miller, Stolen Youth (2013). The following year, he signed with No I.D.'s ARTium Recordings, an imprint of Def Jam Recordings, to release his debut extended play, Hell Can Wait (2014), which received critical acclaim and marked his first entry on the Billboard 200.

facts: He signed with Talib Kweli's Blacksmith Records prior to the release of his collaborative mixtape with Mac Miller, Stolen Youth (2013).
The following year, he signed with No I.D.'s ARTium Recordings, an imprint of Def Jam Recordings, to release his debut extended play, Hell Can Wait (2014).

de.who: Vincent Jamal Staples ist ein amerikanischer Rapper, Sänger, Songwriter und Schauspieler. Bekannt wurde er zunächst durch seine Auftritte auf Projekten von Odd-Future-Mitgliedern und deren Umfeld.
facts: Er unterschrieb bei Talib Kwelis Label Blacksmith Records, kurz bevor das gemeinsame Mixtape Stolen Youth (2013) mit Mac Miller erschien.
Im folgenden Jahr unterschrieb er bei ARTium Recordings von No I.D., einem Imprint von Def Jam Recordings, um sein Debüt-EP Hell Can Wait (2014) zu veröffentlichen.

facts: Mac Miller ile ortak miksteypi Stolen Youth (2013) yayımlanmadan önce Talib Kweli'nin Blacksmith Records plağıyla anlaşma imzaladı.
Ertesi yıl No I.D.'nin, Def Jam Recordings'in bir alt etiketi olan ARTium Recordings ile anlaşma imzalayarak ilk genişletilmiş oyunu Hell Can Wait'i (2014) çıkardı.

nights.title: The Amity Affliction: HOUSE OF CARDS 2026
nights.name: The Amity Affliction
nights.extract: The Amity Affliction is an Australian metalcore band originally from Gympie, Queensland, formed in 2003. The band currently consists of Joel Birch, Dan Brown (guitar) and Jonathan Reeves. The band has released nine studio albums – the most recent of which, House of Cards, was released in 2026. They are known for their highly personal songs, often dealing with depression, anxiety, death, substance abuse, and suicide, many lyrics stemming from vocalist Joel Birch's past struggles.

nights.title: CHIEF KEEF
nights.name: Chief Keef
nights.extract: Keith Farrelle Cozart, known professionally as Chief Keef, is an American rapper and record producer. Beginning his career as a teenager, he gained regional recognition for his mixtapes in the early 2010s. Cozart has since been credited with popularizing the hip hop subgenre drill among mainstream audiences and is considered a progenitor of the genre.

nights.title: Sammy Rae & The Friends - the GET DOWN!
nights.name: Sammy Rae & The Friends
nights.extract: Sammy Rae & The Friends is an American jazz-pop band from Brooklyn, New York City, led by singer-songwriter Samantha "Sammy Rae" Bowers. Formed in 2016, the group is known for high-energy live shows; in February 2024 they played two sold-out nights at Washington, D.C.’s 9:30 Club. Their debut studio album, Something for Everybody, was released on September 20, 2024, via Nettwerk, following the EPs The Good Life (2018) and Let's Throw a Party (2021).
